description: Sixth/final evidence-driven refinement: optimistic_adam was the only proposal to end at 8 ring modes/HQ1 but acquired too late and lost rare shape. Isolate its correction to D only; all G/prior/auxiliary Adam updates remain original. For D use ordinary Adam direction u_t and add lr_t*(u_t-u_previous), first step ordinary. Original schedule rescales the uncorrected previous direction by CURRENT lr. This tests critic game-memory damping without amplifying sparse G/prior directions. No extra forward/backward or optimizer calls. Save own final model/optimizer/RNG state for conditional continuation only after all gates.
initialization: retained audited CPU fixtures; native CUDA training and random draws

compute.base_updates: one D and one G per host outer step; no added critic steps
compute.comparison: equal outer steps and equal model/gradient evaluations; added tensor arithmetic/memory, wall time measured

checkpoint: memory stored in optimizer state; qualification continuation required after all 22
